responsibility: This header declares the public top-level compiler driver interfaces and global state managed by toplev.cc. It exposes saved decoded option vectors, the toplev class that runs or finalizes a compiler invocation, and assorted compiler-wide entry points and globals such as declaration compilation hooks, source-directory helpers, random-seed accessors, initialization helpers, version printing, and the identifier hash table handle used by front ends.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/toplev.cc, which implements the compiler invocation workflow and owns the corresponding global state definitions, this header is the declaration surface that exposes the toplev class, saved option vectors, compiler-wide globals, and helper entry points to the rest of GCC.
